summary: Revmo AI is a Phoenix-based conversational AI company, led by CEO Ryan Louis, providing voice, text, and email automation (including phone order-taking) for restaurants, with a proprietary "INSANO Mode" voice engine supporting secure credit-card processing and automatic coupon recognition.

Donatos Pizza selected Revmo AI as its voice-ordering partner in April 2025, replacing DoorDash's AI phone-ordering feature, with a rollout planned across all 174 Donatos locations nationwide by May 2025; Donatos reportedly evaluated SoundHound and Kea before choosing Revmo. (Scope note: Single named customer deal; not proof of broader market share versus SoundHound, Kea, or other voice-AI vendors mentioned as having been evaluated.)
